notes.title: Meet the Cauterizer!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44045978/945524d2dd4a82d30d9adf6649f1a86b419f3eae.png"]Feel The Burn! 


Cauterizers are our newest enemy type, and they can be found in the Arena as of the 0.7.3 update to Transfusion. 



Unlike all the enemies up to this point, which rush and overwhelm you, this fearsome foe will try to keep its distance and throw fireballs from afar!



These fireballs deal a considerable amount of damage, but take note that you're not the only one that can get hurt by them...


Patch Notes 0.7.3Updates:
Added a new enemy type - Cauterizers. These enemies will attempt to keep their distance and throw fireballs at the player.

Added graphics settings in settings menu

Added “holsters” at the player’s sides to hold weapons when not in use

Added invisible walls while platforms are raising with new enemies

Enemy tails now move with ragdoll physics
Bugfixes:
Some changes to the save system to track settings separately from game progress

Movement vignette now accounts for vertical movement in addition to horizontal

Various minor fixes

notes.title: Bugfix Patch v0.6.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug that was preventing earning progress towards the achievement "Heads Up"

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.0 - Achievements!
notes.content:
Updates

Added initial set of achievements
Randomized order that platforms lower in Arcade Mode
New effects when unlocking weapons
Slight improvements to tracking weapon velocity

Bugfixes

Fixed an issue with hit reactions
Fixed a bug that could cause the player’s hand to disappear after picking up a dismembered limb
Other misc code optimizations

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.5.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug where depending on play space, the player could spawn on the arena elevator outside of the trigger for making it go up to start the level
